55901.meaning1: (gram) is elided; is dropped; is cut off

examples.text: asamānarūpā saramhā paro saro vā lupyate.

55903.commentary: (MNt) lubbhanalakkhaṇo'ti ārammaṇassa abhigijjhanalakkhaṇo. tathā hi so lubbhanti tena, sayaṃ vā lubbhati, lubbhanamattam'eva vā tan'ti lobho'ti vuccati.

examples.text: lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho'ti yattha katthaci lubbhanalakkhaṇo lobho ca, dussanalakkhaṇo doso ca, majjanalakkhaṇo mado ca, muyhanalakkhaṇo moho ca.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto āvilo luḷito kalalībhūto andhakāre nikkhitto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ na jāneyya na passeyya.
ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ bhagavā etadavoca, api nu te, gahapati, kule dānaṃ dīyatī'ti? dīyati me, bhante, kule dānaṃ. tañ'ca kho lūkhaṃ kaṇājakaṃ biḷaṅgadutiyan'ti.
yaṃ kho pan'assa bhojanaṃ denti, lūkhaṃ vā paṇītaṃ vā, taṃ sakkaccaṃ'y'eva paribhuñjati avihaññamāno.

55913.commentary: (SNa) lūkhaṃ tapan'ti pañc'ātapatāpanaṃ kaṇṭakaseyy'ādikaṃ tapaṃ. (SNt) lūkhaṃ tapan'ti attakilamath'ānuyogaṃ.

examples.text: taṇh'ādhipannā vatasīlabaddhā, lūkhaṃ tapaṃ vassasataṃ carantā, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

yassa kassaci, āvuso, bhikkhuno ime pāpakā akusalā icch'āvacarā appahīnā dissanti c'eva sūyanti ca, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti āraññiko pantasen'āsano piṇḍapātiko sapadānacārī paṃsukūliko lūkhacīvaradharo, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na c'eva sakkaronti na garuṃ karonti na mānenti na pūjenti.

55915.meaning1: wearing rough robes; dressed in coarse cloth

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena sambahulā bhikkhuniyo gāmak'āvāse vassaṃvuṭṭhā sāvatthiṃ agamaṃsu vattasampannā iriyāpathasampannā duccoḷā lūkhacīvarā.

55916.meaning1: ascetic who wears a coarse robe

examples.text: yassa kassaci, āvuso, bhikkhuno ime pāpakā akusalā icch'āvacarā appahīnā dissanti c'eva sūyanti ca, kiñ'c'āpi so hoti āraññiko pantasen'āsano piṇḍapātiko sapadānacārī paṃsukūliko lūkhacīvaradharo, atha kho naṃ sabrahmacārī na c'eva sakkaronti na garuṃ karonti na mānenti na pūjenti.

55917.meaning1: living roughly; performing rough ascetic practices
55917.commentary: (SNa) lūkhajīvin'ti lūkhajīvikaṃ. (SNt) so pana anekāk'ārabhedena lūkhaṃ pharusaṃ jīvanasīlattā lūkhajīvī nāma.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho rāsiyo gāmaṇi bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkhajīviṃ ek'aṃsena upavadati upakkosatī'ti.

55919.meaning1: having confidence in austerity; having faith based on simplicity; pleased by asceticism

55920.meaning1: wearing a rough cloak; dressed in a shabby overgarment

examples.text: sāvatthinidānaṃ. atha kho aññataro brāhmaṇamahāsālo lūkho lūkhapāpuraṇo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

55921.meaning1: wearing a rough cloak; dressed in a shabby overgarment

examples.text: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi. ekam'antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho taṃ brāhmaṇamahāsālaṃ bhagavā etadavoca, kin'nu tvaṃ, brāhmaṇa, lūkho lūkhapāvuraṇo'ti? idha me, bho gotama, cattāro puttā.

55922.meaning1: who measures by austerity; appraising by simplicity; who judges on the basis of asceticism

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

55923.meaning1: who has confidence in austerity; whose faith is based on simplicity; pleased by asceticism
55923.meaning2: devoted to a person who is shabby

examples.text: rūpappamāṇo rūpappasanno, ghosappamāṇo ghosappasanno, lūkhappamāṇo lūkhappasanno, dhammappamāṇo dhammappasanno. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin'ti.

55924.meaning1: with a rough way of life
55924.commentary: (DNa) lūkh'ājīvin'ti acelaka-mutt'ācār'ādi-vasena lūkho ājīvo assā'ti lūkh'ājīvī, taṃ lūkh'ājīviṃ. (DNa) ekaccaṃ tapassiṃ lūkh'ājīvin'ti-ādīsu idh'ekacco acelakapabbajj'ādi-tapanissitattā tapassī lūkhena jīvitaṃ kappessāmī'ti tiṇa-gomay'ādi-bhakkhan'ādīhi nānappakārehi attānaṃ kilameti, appapuññatāya ca sukhena jīvitavuttim'eva na labhati, so tīṇi duccaritāni pūretvā niraye nibbattati. (DNa) lūkh'ājīvin'ti acelakādi-vasena vā dhutaṅgavasena vā lūkh'ājīviṃ. (DNt) lūkhaṃ vā pharusaṃ sādhusammat'ācāra-virahato napasādanīyaṃ ājīvati vattatī'ti lūkh'ājīvī, taṃ lūkh'ājīviṃ. muttācārādī'ti

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bho gotama, samaṇo gotamo sabbaṃ tapaṃ garahati, sabbaṃ tapassiṃ lūkh'ājīviṃ ek'aṃsena upakkosati upavadatī'ti.

55927.commentary: (THIa) lūnakesī'ti lūnā luñcitā kesā mayhan'ti lūnakesī, nigaṇṭhesu pabbajjāya tālaṭṭhinā luñcitakesā, taṃ sandhāya vadati.

examples.text: lūnakesī paṅkadharī, ekasāṭī pure cariṃ, avajje vajjamatinī, vajje c'āvajjadassinī.
ettakā ajā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā urabbhā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā assā haññantu yaññ'atthāya, ettakā rukkhā chijjantu yūp'atthāya, ettakā dabbhā lūyantu barihis'atthāyā'ti.

tasmiṃ kho, brāhmaṇa, yaññe n'eva gāvo haññiṃsu, na aj'eḷakā haññiṃsu, na kukkuṭasūkarā haññiṃsu, na vividhā pāṇā saṃghātaṃ āpajjiṃsu, na rukkhā chijjiṃsu yūp'atthāya, na dabbhā lūyiṃsu barihis'atthāya

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā

sākhāpalāsaṃ suvisodhitaṃ visodhetvā kuṭhārīhi taccheyya, kuṭhārīhi tacchetvā vāsīhi taccheyya, vāsīhi tacchetvā lekhaṇiyā likheyya, lekhaṇiyā likhitvā pāsāṇaguḷena dhoveyya, pāsāṇaguḷena dhovetvā nadiṃ patāreyya.
tayo'me, bhikkhave, puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ. katame tayo? pāsāṇalekhā-upamo puggalo, pathavilekhā-upamo puggalo, udakalekhā-upamo puggalo.
lekhāya saṃvaṇṇeti nāma lekhaṃ chindati, yo evaṃ marati so dhanaṃ vā labhati yasaṃ vā labhati saggaṃ vā gacchatī'ti, akkhar'akkharāya āpatti dukkaṭassa.

55940.commentary: (THIa) cittakārasukatā'va lekhikā'ti cittakārena sippinā nīlāya vaṇṇadhātuyā suṭṭhu katā lekhā viya sobhate.

examples.text: cittakārasukatā'va lekhikā, sobhare su bhamukā pure mama, tā jarāya valibhippalambitā, saccavādivacanaṃ anaññathā.

tasmā't'iha, phagguna, tava ce'pi koci pāṇinā pahāraṃ dadeyya, leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dadeyya, daṇḍena pahāraṃ dadeyya, satthena pahāraṃ dadeyya, tatrā'pi tvaṃ, phagguna, ye gehasitā chandā ye gehasitā vitakkā te pajaheyyāsi.
yadā kho, bhikkhave, aññāsi lāpo sakuṇo bahuāgato kho my'āyaṃ sakuṇagghī'ti, atha tass'eva leḍḍussa antaraṃ paccupādi. atha kho, bhikkhave, sakuṇagghi tatth'eva uraṃ paccatāḷesi.

55942.meaning1: place where there are clods of earth

examples.text: ko pana te, lāpa, gocaro sako pettiko visayo'ti? yadidaṃ, naṅgalakaṭṭhakaraṇaṃ leḍḍuṭṭhānan'ti.

55943.commentary: (VINa) leḍḍupāto'ti yathā mātugāmo kāke uḍḍāpento ujukam'eva hatthaṃ ukkhipitvā leḍḍuṃ khipati, yathā ca udak'ukkhepe udakaṃ khipanti, evaṃ akhipitvā yathā taruṇamanussā attano balaṃ dassentā bāhaṃ pasāretvā leḍḍuṃ khipanti, evaṃ khittassa leḍḍussa patanaṭṭhānaṃ

examples.text: gām'ūpacāro nāma parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīle ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto, aparikkhittassa gāmassa ghar'ūpacāre ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.
anāpucchaṃ vā gaccheyyā'ti bhikkhuṃ vā sāmaṇeraṃ vā ārāmikaṃ vā anāpucchā majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupātaṃ atikkamantassa āpatti pācittiyassa.
tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare aniṭṭhehi akantehi amanāpehi samudācaranti, pāṇisamphassena'pi leḍḍusamphassena'pi daṇḍasamphassena'pi satthasamphassena'pi.
so evaṃ pajānāti, tathābhūto kho ayaṃ kāyo yathābhūtasmiṃ kāye pāṇisamphassā'pi kamanti, leḍḍusamphassā'pi kamanti, daṇḍasamphassā'pi kamanti, satthasamphassā'pi kamanti.
bhante, idaṃ udakaṃ dārakassa sīse āsiñcāmā'ti āpucchitvā, tena hi āsiñcathā'ti vutte tathā akāsi. sā devatā tāva'd'eva taṃ muñcitvā gantvā leṇadvāre aṭṭhāsi.
anāpatti leṇe guhāya tiṇakuṭikāya aññass'atthāya vās'āgāraṃ ṭhapetvā sabbattha, anāpatti ummattakassa ādikammikassā'ti.

atha kho saccako nigaṇṭhaputto bhīto saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto bhagavantaṃ'y'eva tāṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva leṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ'y'eva saraṇaṃ gavesī bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, pucchatu maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo, byākarissāmī'ti.
taṃ suṇātha. katamañ'ca, bhikkhave, leṇaṃ… tāṇañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi tāṇagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

55949.commentary: (SNa) lepaṃ oḍḍentī'ti vaṭarukkhakhīr'ādīhi yojetvā lepaṃ karonti, taṃ makkaṭānaṃ dhuvagamanaṭṭhānan'ti sallakkhetvā rukkhasākh'ādīsu ṭhapenti.

examples.text: tatra, bhikkhave, luddā makkaṭavīthīsu lepaṃ oḍḍenti makkaṭānaṃ bādhanāya.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso lepagatena hatthena sākhaṃ gaṇheyya, tassa so hattho sajjeyyapi gaṇheyyapi bajjheyyapi, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhu aññataraṃ santaṃ cetovimuttiṃ upasampajja viharati. so sakkāyanirodhaṃ manasi karoti.
aṭṭhīnaṃ nagaraṃ kataṃ, maṃsalohitalepanaṃ, yattha jarā ca maccu ca, māno makkho ca ohito.
kiss'ābhilepanaṃ brūsī'ti kiṃ lokassa lepanaṃ lagganaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso.
saṭṭhikaṇḍarasambandho, maṃsalepanalepito, cammakañcukasannaddho, pūtikāyo niratthako.

55960.meaning2: having plastered, having coated with, having smeared

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, dakkhiṇesu janapadesu dhovanaṃ nāma. tattha hoti annam'pi pānam'pi khajjam'pi bhojjam'pi leyyam'pi peyyam'pi naccam'pi gītam'pi vāditam'pi. atth'etaṃ, bhikkhave, dhovanaṃ, n'etaṃ n'atthī'ti vadāmi.

55964.meaning2: fit to be licked or sipped

gamanena na pattabbo, lokass'anto kudācanaṃ, na ca appatvā lok'antaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.
iti uddham'adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabb'attatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyābajjhena pharitvā viharati.
ayaṃ loko paro loko, brahmaloko sadevako, diṭṭhiṃ te n'ābhijānāti, gotamassa yasassino.
pāpāni parivajjeti, sa munī tena so muni, yo munāti ubho loke, muni tena pavuccati.

55975.meaning1: world of experience; (comm) world of aggregates, sense spheres and elements

55977.meaning2: Chapter 12 of the Saḷāyatanasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 4 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

55978.meaning1: tales about the world; legends of the land
55978.commentary: (ANa) lokakkhāyikā nāma ayaṃ loko kena nimmito? asukena nāma nimmito. kāko seto aṭṭhīnaṃ setattā, balākā rattā lohitassa rattattā'ti'evam'ādikā lok'āyatavitaṇḍasallāpakathā.

examples.text: nigamakathaṃ nagarakathaṃ janapadakathaṃ itthikathaṃ sūrakathaṃ visikhākathaṃ kumbhaṭṭhānakathaṃ pubbapetakathaṃ nānattakathaṃ lok'akkhāyikaṃ samudd'akkhāyikaṃ itibhav'ābhavakathaṃ iti vāti

55979.meaning1: who is foremost in the world; who is supreme in the universe

examples.text: yadā vipassī lok'aggo, āyusaṅkhāram'ossaji, pathavī sampakampittha, medanī jalamekhalā.

55980.meaning1: beautiful things in the world; various objects in the world

examples.text: sabbaloke anabhiratasaññāparicitena, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno cetasā bahulaṃ viharato lokacitresu cittaṃ patilīyati patikuṭati pativattati, na sampasāriyati upekkhā vā pāṭikulyatā vā saṇṭhāti.

55981.meaning1: speculation about the world; thoughts about (the origin of) the universe
55981.commentary: (ANa) lokacintā'ti kena nu kho candimasūriyā katā, kena mahāpathavī, kena mahāsamuddo, kena sattā uppāditā, kena pabbatā, kena ambatālanāḷiker'ādayo'ti evarūpā lokacintā.

examples.text: lokacintā, bhikkhave, acinteyyā, na cintetabbā, yaṃ cintento ummādassa vighātassa bhāgī assa.

55982.meaningLit: discourse on speculation about the world

55983.meaning1: supreme in the world; most distinguished among men; epithet of the Buddha

examples.text: s'āhaṃ disvāna sambuddhaṃ, lokajeṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ, tassa pādāni vanditvā, ekam'antaṃ upāvisiṃ.
no ce buddhaṃ sareyyātha, lokajeṭṭhaṃ nar'āsabhaṃ, atha dhammaṃ sareyyātha, niyyānikaṃ sudesitaṃ.

55984.meaning1: worldly matter; things of the world; vicissitudes of life
55984.commentary: (KHPa) phuṭṭhassa lokadhammehi… nāma yassa lābh'ālābh'ādīhi aṭṭhahi lokadhammehi phuṭṭhassa

examples.text: phuṭṭhassa lokadhammehi, cittaṃ yassa na kampati, asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

55985.meaning1: worldly phenomenon; common condition; (comm) crumbling character of the five aggregates

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, loke lokadhammo, taṃ tathāgato abhisambujjhati abhisameti, abhisambujjhitvā abhisametvā taṃ ācikkhati deseti paññapeti paṭṭhapeti vivarati vibhajati uttānīkaroti.

55986.commentary: (SNa) dasasahassacakkavāḷañ'hi idha dasalokadhātuyo'ti adhippetaṃ. tena vuttaṃ, dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatā yebhuyyena sannipatitā hontī'ti.

examples.text: dasahi ca lokadhātūhi devatā yebhuyyena sannipatitā honti bhagavantaṃ dassanāya bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca

55987.meaning1: saviour of the world; protector of the planet

examples.text: vandanaṃ dāni vajjāsi, lokanāthaṃ anuttaraṃ, padakkhiṇañ'ca katvāna, ādiseyyāsi dakkhiṇaṃ.
aññathā lokanāthamhi, tiṭṭhante puris'uttame, iriyaṃ āsi bhikkhūnaṃ, aññathā dāni dissati.

55988.meaning1: world leader; master of the earth; guide to the world

examples.text: dassanaṃ me atikkante, sasaṅghe lokanāyake, sayanā vuṭṭhahitvāna, pallaṅkaṃ ābhujiṃ tadā.
bhavanā abhinikkhamma, addasaṃ lokanāyakaṃ, indīvaraṃ'va jalitaṃ, ādittaṃ'va hut'āsanaṃ.
imā kho citta, lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo, yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasan'ti.

55990.meaning1: ending of the world; cessation of the world; (comm) truth of cessation

examples.text: lokasamudayaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke n'atthitā sā na hoti. lokanirodhaṃ kho, kaccāna, yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya passato yā loke atthitā sā na hoti.
api c'āhaṃ imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

55991.meaning1: path of practice leading to the end of the world; (comm) truth of the path

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

55992.meaning1: leading to the end of the world

examples.text: api c'āhaṃ, āvuso, imasmiṃ'y'eva byāmamatte kaḷebare sasaññimhi samanake lokañ'ca paññāpemi lokasamudayañ'ca lokanirodhañ'ca lokanirodhagāminiñ'ca paṭipadan'ti.

55993.meaning1: escape from the world; way out of the world
55993.commentary: (ANa) idaṃ lokanissaraṇan'ti idaṃ nibbānaṃ lokato nissaṭattā lokanissaraṇan'ti vuccati.

examples.text: tassa hi idaṃ niccaṃ dhuvaṃ sassataṃ acavanadhammaṃ, ito aññaṃ lokanissaraṇaṃ nibbānaṃ nāma n'atthī'ti evaṃ diṭṭhi uppajji.
gamanena na pattabbo, lokass'anto kudācanaṃ, na ca appatvā lok'antaṃ, dukkhā atthi pamocanaṃ.

55995.meaningLit: discourse on going to the end of the world

55996.meaning1: who has gone to the end of the world
55996.meaning2: who has reached the end of the things worldly

examples.text: paroparā yassa samecca dhammā, vidhūpitā atthagatā na santi, sa ve muni vusitabrahmacariyo, lok'antagū pāragato'ti vuccatī'ti.
tasmā have lokavidū sumedho, lok'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.

55997.meaning2: different world, space between the worlds

55998.commentary: (MNa) lok'antarikā'ti tiṇṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ cakkavāḷānaṃ antarā ek'eko lok'antarikā hoti, tiṇṇaṃ sakaṭacakkānaṃ pattānaṃ vā aññam'aññaṃ āhacca ṭhapitānaṃ majjhe okāso viya. so pana lok'antarikanirayo parimāṇato aṭṭhayojanasahasso hoti.

examples.text: yā'pi tā lok'antarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yattha'p'ime candimasūriyā evaṃmah'iddhikā evaṃmah'ānubhāvā ābhāya n'ānubhonti tattha'pi appamāṇo uḷāro obhāso loke pātubhavati atikkamm'eva devānaṃ dev'ānubhāvaṃ.
imā kho citta, lokasamaññā lokaniruttiyo lokavohārā lokapaññattiyo, yāhi tathāgato voharati aparāmasan'ti.
